metadata.title: On the Orbital Effects of Stellar Collisions in Galactic Nuclei: Tidal Disruption Events and Ejected Stars

notes: No eligible stars. The paper reports statistical results for anonymous simulated sample stars rather than identifying individual objects with names or source IDs. The “unbound” or ejected stars discussed at T:p10-b6 and T:p11-b5 are simulation members without individual identifiers, so they cannot be recorded as identifiable Galactic unbound candidates.
